features.title: Application fit
features.desc: Confirm the medium, normal and maximum pressure, process temperature, ambient conditions and mounting location before selecting the measuring principle and range.

features.title: Verifiable data
features.desc: Ranges, accuracy classes, nameplate markings and visible construction are reported as observed; unconfirmed values are not generalized across models.

features.title: Materials and connections
features.desc: Specify wetted materials, seals, thread or flange standard and pressure rating against the medium and piping conditions.

features.title: Installation and maintenance
features.desc: Account for orientation, vibration, pressure pulsation and service clearance during selection; add damping, isolation or protection where required.

about.title: About Jingfeng Instruments
about.subtitle: Measuring what matters in industrial processes since 2008.
about.story: Founded in Bengbu, Anhui in 2008, Anhui Jingfeng Instrument Co., Ltd. designs and manufactures process measurement instruments for the world's most demanding industries. From our first pressure transmitter to today's full range of pressure, temperature and level instruments, we have shipped to plants in over 40 countries.
about.mission: Make reliable, certified process measurement accessible to every industrial operation — without the premium import price tag.
